scope: Read current human-screening progress from the protected working CSV for the local dashboard without returning any entered research content.

delivered.dashboard_behavior: The local project-status endpoint now recalculates aggregate screening totals and input state from working/screening_30.csv.
delivered.privacy_boundary: The browser receives only counts and state. Screener names, decisions, reasons, notes, source locators and individual timings are not returned.
delivered.input_boundary: An unavailable or invalid working CSV reports a generic input-state warning. Detailed diagnostics remain local to the screening-report command.
delivered.visual_behavior: The frontend shows completed/expected screening count together with the current aggregate status.

covered_cases: The untouched local working CSV reports 0 of 30 completed and valid aggregate input.
A missing working input reports INPUT_UNAVAILABLE without error detail.
A completed aggregate result is passed through without any CSV content.
The local frontend, middleware and backend integration preserves loopback-only and temporary-workbook safeguards.

workbook_formula_execution.reason: The supplied 114-scenario suite still needs a healthy isolated LibreOffice or Excel installation. The earlier Excel smoke attempt ended at an Office repair prompt, which was not accepted.

publication: LOCAL_ONLY; no GitHub push, deployment, external sharing or research conclusion was made
